function msgQDrop(m,key){ var i; while((i=msgQFind(m,key))>=0){ G.msgQ.splice(i,1); G.msgQM.splice(i,1); } }
function netSndLabel(on){ return on?'SOUND ON':'SOUND OFF'; }
